title: "James G. Baker" – portrait of U-2 camera lens designer (Chapter 2, p. 50)
description: Black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of a man in a suit and tie, captioned "James G. Baker." The adjacent text describes Baker's work with Richard Perkin of Perkin-Elmer on high-acuity lenses and his adaptation of the Hycon K-38 aerial camera into the A-1 system for the U-2.
